articles.title: UP steps upIT policy pushfor $1 tn Goal
articles.summary: UP reviews IT and electronics policies, urging faster project approvals and incentives to boost AI, semiconductors and data centres for $1 tn economy goal.
articles.body: Lucknow: The state’s IT and electronics department on Wednesday held a meeting to assess the implementation of its investment and technology policies, with IT and electronics minister Sunil Kumar Sharma directing officials to speed up projects, incentives and initiatives aimed at strengthening the sector’s contribution to UP’s $ 1 trillion economy target.Progress of the IT policy, electronics manufacturing policy, semiconductor policy, data centre policy, startup policy and provisions related to global capability centres (GCCs) were reviewed. Sharma said the IT and electronics sector had an important role in achieving UP’s $ 1 trillion economy target and stressed that effective implementation of policies and creation of an investor-friendly environment were necessary to translate investment proposals into projects. He directed officials to ensure that benefits of incentives and initiatives reached investors, companies and young people.“Investment in the technology sector should not only strengthen the state’s economy but also create opportunities for employment and entrepreneurship for the youth,” Sharma said.The review focused on emerging sectors, including artificial intelligence, semiconductors, electronics manufacturing and data centres. articles.title: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald shares heartfelt message about Chargers' Jim Harbaugh
articles.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald had nothing but praise for Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh ahead of their Week 4 matchup.
articles.body:
The Chargers are looking for their first win of the season in Week 4, but it won't be easy as they face the defending Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks .

It'll be a tall task, as the Chargers will head to the Pacific Northwest for their second road game of the season.

Seattle's crowd is rowdy, and head coach Mike Macdonald has led the team back to where they were in the early to mid 2010s. Macdonald was clearly a home run hire for the Seahawks; however, before that, he was one of Jim Harbaugh's coordinators.

The two spent the 2021 season together in Michigan, and Macdonald will never forget it. Before their Week 4 matchup, Macdonald reevaluated why he's forever grateful to the Harbaugh family, especially Jim.

"I had the honor of working for both Jim and John, one year with Jim," Macdonald said .

"He [Jim] gave me so much autonomy and, like, the belief that he had in our staff on defense and in me personally as well.

"It felt like he never left your corner. We had a blast that year in Ann Arbor, and I'm just proud to say that we worked for him and are proud of the year that we had."

Harbaugh and Macdonald spent the 2021 season together at Michigan. Macdonald served as the Wolverines' defensive coordinator, leading them to a top-10 national defense, an undefeated home record, the Big Ten Conference Championship, and a College Football Playoff appearance.

The Wolverines finished No. 3 overall that season and went 12-2.

After that lone season, Macdonald spent two seasons as the Ravens ' defensive coordinator before the Seahawks hired him as head coach.

articles.title: Blanca Félix and Jasmine Casarez Called Up to Mexico Women’s National Team for FIFA Window!
articles.summary: Great news, Red-and-White Nation! The Mexico Women’s National Team has announced its squad for the October FIFA international window on home soil, and, as ex...
articles.body:
Great news, Red-and-White Nation ! The Mexico Women's National Team has announced its squad for the October FIFA international window on home soil, and, as expected, Chivas will be represented by two players.

Once again, Blanca Félix and Jasmine Casarez have been named to head coach Pedro López's squad for El Tri's two preparation matches ahead of the 2026 Concacaf W Championship, where Mexico will look to secure a place at the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup.

Mexico will face Jamaica twice, first in Aguascalientes on Friday, October 9, followed by a second match on Tuesday, October 13, in Querétaro.

Blanca and 'Jas' will join the national team following Chivas Femenil's Apertura 2026 Matchday 10 clash against FC Juárez.
